title: Headless Frontend
tagline: Drive and test apps from ABAP. No browser, no UI5, no HTTP.
summary: Drive and test apps from ABAP. No browser, no UI5, no HTTP.
useWhen: Use when writing ABAP Unit tests for an app: z2ui5_cl_frontend_sim plays the browser - sets values, fires events, reads the view and the messages - instead of a hand-written double of the client.
